Subject: SIG follow-up — long-term log retention / customer access model

Vanessa,

Thanks again for walking through the SIG workbook earlier this week. A couple of items the auditors flagged that we need clarified in writing for our internal compliance review:

1) Long-term retention: we need a documented retention policy for tenant audit events beyond 1 year (our regulator requires 3 years for retention guarantees). Can Redwood commit to a retention configuration that preserves immutable event records for 36 months? If not, what export/escrow alternatives do you support?

2) Customer access: in the SIG you indicate customers can request exports of their tenant events. We need a clear operational flow for (a) self-service exports vs (b) time-limited interactive access (read-only) into an environment for forensic analysis. For (b), is there a way to provide time-bounded access without sharing production credentials or creating a permanent account?

3) Evidence format: our legal team prefers NDJSON event dumps and a signed manifest. Could you provide a sample export (a few hundred events) so our auditors can validate schema + signature?

We'd like to keep this concise — can you send a proposed short playbook (1-2 pages) that we can attach to the SIG as an appendix?

Samuel
Security & Risk, FinBridge
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Park <samuel.park@finbridge.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — long-term log retention / customer access model

Sam —

Appreciate the clear ask. High level answers below; Im looping Neha and Laura to confirm the security/process details and attach a short playbook + a sample NDJSON extract.

- Retention: Redwood supports configurable retention per-tenant. Default hosted retention is 1 year; we offer 36-month retention as a managed add-on (requires a reserved configuration + additional storage tier). If you need immutability guarantees we can place exported snapshots into an encrypted S3 escrow (signed manifest + object versioning) that we maintain for the contract term.

- Customer access model: two supported flows:
  * Self-serve export: customer can request a tenant export via Console or API; export job produces an NDJSON bundle and a SHA256 manifest.
  * Time-limited forensic access: we offer ephemeral read-only sessions via a jump-host into a sanitized audit environment for approved requests. Sessions are requested via Support/PS and require an access justification and expiry window (max 72 hours) — all session activity is recorded.

- Evidence format: attaching a small sample NDJSON and manifest for schema validation.

I'll follow up with an internal note describing operational SLAs for exports and the contractual language we typically add to addenda. If you want the S3 escrow option, Marcus can coordinate pricing and retention terms.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: FW: SIG follow-up — retention / access playbook (draft)

Vanessa / Marcus —

Drafting a concise playbook as requested. Key operational items I will include:

1) Export SLA: 24-72 hours from request depending on bundle size; expedited within 8 hours for legal holds (requires escalation).
2) Export contents: NDJSON + signed manifest (SHA256), timestamp, export job id, schema version.
3) Escrow model: weekly snapshots of tenant events can be copied to an encrypted S3 bucket with object-lock retention for the contract term. Escrow retrieval requires a signed request from the customer and our legal review.
4) Ephemeral sessions: approval flow = customer request -> Redwood security review -> PS approval -> session creation (72h max) -> session is recorded and PA-reviewed.
5) Auditability: every export and session creation is logged internally (operator id, timestamp, justification) and surfaced to the customer in a summary CSV.

I attached a sample event extract and the access matrix for internal sign-off. Marcus, please confirm commercial add-on pricing for the escrow option and the optional expedited export.
